Indian Teqball Players Miss Bronze at Asian Games

At the Asian Games in Nagoya, Indian teqball player Quimcy Dsouza lost narrowly to Japan’s Sakamoto in the singles bronze‑medal match, missing a chance to win bronze. In the doubles event, Indian player Mohamed Anas also failed to secure a bronze after a close contest. Both athletes therefore left the Games without a medal in teqball.
